name: Mr D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad
summary: Mr D.I.Y. Group (M) Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the retail of home improvement products, mass merchandise, games, toys, groceries, and related business and activities in Malaysia and Brunei.
